description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete a voice agent

Deletes a voice agent permanently and removes it from the voice engine. This cannot be undone, and any phone number still routed to this agent stops being answered by it. Its integration links and knowledge entries are deleted with it, and so are the indexed knowledge documents that no other agent uses. The removal in the voice engine is attempted first, but a failure there does not stop the local deletion, so the agent always disappears from the account. This endpoint takes no request body.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: delete_agent
